name: Ashbound Hall
summary: Ashbound Hall is a specialized prison from Coldharbour that has fallen to Nirn. Salt-Air Station lies along the coast northeast of this location, while the Lair of the Black Worm sits off the side of the road to the northwest. A warning is posted beside Sirilonwe's camp along the road north of the prison. A Soul Shriven Bard is playing the flute in the wilderness southeast of the hall. Terinvel's Notebook and An Offer of Protection can be found at a camp near the hall during the related quest. Hazards include vampiric runes and volcanic activity.
